# Delivery risks

| ID | Risk | Likelihood | Impact | Mitigation | Owner/status |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|---|
| R-001 | Contract snapshot drifts from running backend | medium | high | SHA lock, generated types, contract check and real-stack integration tests | engineering / open |
| R-002 | Refresh-token handling leaks or races across concurrent requests/instances | medium | critical | AES-GCM httpOnly session, per-session single-flight refresh, no browser storage, concurrency unit test; shared lock/session store remains a production multi-instance prerequisite | Phase 03 mitigated locally / deployment open |
| R-003 | Prototype data is mistaken for business data | high | high | remove mock production routes; explicit offline/unreachable states only | Phase 01 |
| R-004 | Studio suggests edits reach customers before adapters ship | high | high | persistent capability/status disclosure and release gating | Phases 10–15 |
| R-005 | Untyped admin bodies cause accidental contract invention | high | high | treat as `unknown`, capture real responses, add endpoint parsers | ongoing |
| R-006 | MFA-required action is exposed as an ordinary submit or retried after an ambiguous result | medium | high | backend MFA_REQUIRED opens the global dialog; exact request retries once only after verification; cancellation and non-MFA failures are not replayed | Phase 03 mitigated |
| R-007 | PII or bearer-like codes leak into screenshots/logs/exports | medium | critical | no request-body/token logs, invite codes are manually entered rather than URL parameters, disposable screenshot fixtures, export masking | Phase 03 mitigated / Phase 04 onward |
| R-008 | Shiprocket UI implies a configured live provider | medium | high | provider capability gate; permanent mock-tested-only disclosure | Phase 07 |
| R-009 | Dense operational tables fail keyboard/mobile users | medium | medium | Phase 02 responsive controls, 375/768/1440 Orders screenshots, keyboard labels, axe serious/critical check; 50-row render and assistive-tech profile remain unverified | Phase 04 mitigated / performance profile open |
| R-014 | Visual component fixtures are mistaken for business data | low | medium | dev-only route, explicit fixture disclosure, no reachable operational mock routes | Phase 02 mitigated |
| R-015 | Font build retrieval changes or fails in restricted CI | low | low | `next/font` compiles font assets at build time; keep a production-build gate and do not restore remote CSS imports | Phase 02 open |
| R-016 | Server/client pathname mismatch changes sign-in links during hydration | low | medium | use Next `usePathname()` in the shell and validate it through the safe-next-path helper | Phase 03 mitigated; hydration warning no longer reproduced |
| R-017 | Framework request logs capture invitation codes placed in query strings | medium | high | no token query parsing; invitation code field posts only to same-origin BFF; route/title and e2e keep invite URL query-free | Phase 03 mitigated |
| R-010 | Scope expands to excluded B2B/rider/wallet patterns | medium | medium | parity matrix decision record and architectural lint review | ongoing |
| R-011 | Native dependencies make clean-clone verification flaky | medium | medium | lockfile, documented Node/pnpm, CI-like `pnpm verify` | Phase 01 |
| R-012 | Real backend reset erases local diagnostic state | low | medium | run only documented reset; record reset timing and repeatable seed commands | local dev |
| R-013 | Backend narrative test count differs from owner brief | low | low | preserve actual full-suite log before claiming final test count | open |
| R-018 | Large order CSV exports can exhaust memory because the backend materializes the entire CSV and the browser buffers it as a Blob | medium | high | Cap the UI range at the actual 400-day route limit, explicit export action, never parse/log content; backend streaming or bounded async export remains required before large-scale use | Backend + Phase 18 / open |
| R-019 | Admin list/export contract drift can cause clients to omit required guards or mis-handle pages | medium | high | Runtime schemas, live contract probes, and DASH-BR-003–005; never infer sort/query fields from generic OpenAPI objects | Backend contract owner / open |
| R-020 | Some shared conventions have unit coverage but no safe real-backend mutation proof yet | medium | medium | Do not create unapproved business records; schedule idempotency and upload integrations with the consuming Phase 09/15 flows, and re-run Studio ETag integration when Phase 10 endpoints are available | Dashboard / deferred, decision pending |
| R-021 | No OpenAPI-generated MSW handler or recorded-fixture test harness exists yet | medium | medium | Unit tests mock narrow boundaries; keep fixtures test-only and contract-checked when the harness is added; never let fixtures enter shipped operational routes | Dashboard / follow-up open |
| R-022 | A cached or locally dismissed pause state could let an operator miss a customer-impacting outage | medium | high | Non-dismissible global banner uses public BFF policy, an immediate post-write event, 60-second visible-tab revalidation, and no optimistic “orders resumed” claim | Phase 05 mitigated; cross-device propagation bounded by polling / open |
| R-023 | Generic overview contracts can drift silently, especially nullable settings prerequisites and structured activation failures | medium | high | Narrow Zod parsers, nullable fields covered in unit tests, live shape probes, no fabricated fallback, and DASH-BR-007 | Dashboard + backend contract owner / open |
| R-024 | Invoice GET creates an immutable numbered record and exposes buyer billing PII behind a documented `orders:read` guard | medium | critical | Dashboard BFF requires `orders:fulfil` + AAL2 and explicit confirmation; backend must split read/issue routes, require correct permission/idempotency/reason, and redact fields by role | Backend owner / open, containment in Phase 06 |
| R-025 | Order detail omits customer ID, status/communication timeline and line-level discount/tax/shipping allocation, preventing audited reveal and full financial reconciliation | high | high | Render only authoritative totals, withhold reveal, clearly disclose omissions and request a coherent versioned DTO | Backend contract owner / open |
| R-026 | Return receipt changes inventory behind only `orders:fulfil`; backend omits required `inventory:write` and AAL2 enforcement | medium | critical | Dashboard blocks the receive operation entirely until backend route enforces permission + step-up; never treat client-side MFA as a backend fix | Backend security owner / open, blocks receipt |
| R-027 | Manual shipment event API accepts any valid status without checking forward-only transition, allowing false/out-of-order customer tracking | medium | high | UI offers only conservative next statuses and refetches on conflict; backend must enforce state machine (DASH-BR-014) | Backend implementation owner / open |
| R-028 | Manual shipment cancellation route requires configured provider and cannot operate in manual mode | medium | medium | Hide cancel for manual shipments and state unavailable; backend should support atomic manual cancel/re-ship rules (DASH-BR-011) | Backend implementation owner / open |
| R-029 | Returns/refunds lists return at most 100 rows and cannot paginate; operators may miss older records | medium | high | Label as latest 100 and avoid implying complete history; add cursor pagination before larger operations scale (DASH-BR-015) | Backend implementation owner / open |
| R-030 | Shipping settings and PIN allow-list writes omit mandatory reason/version preconditions; a stale or unaudited write could change dispatch or customer delivery eligibility | medium | high | Keep both dashboard surfaces read-only; require backend-enforced reason + expected version/If-Match and conflict handling before adding controls (DASH-BR-019, ADR-030) | Backend security owner / open |
| R-031 | CSV catalogue commit is not bound to its dry-run and can overwrite a newer or money-affecting variant without a required reason/idempotency key | medium | critical | Do not commit existing-price overwrites; require a server preview token/hash, expected versions, reason and idempotency contract; reconcile ambiguous writes by reads only (DASH-BR-024, ADR-034) | Backend security owner / open |
| R-032 | Price changes do not bump the store rules version, despite owner expectation; quotes are separately revalidated against live variant price at order creation | low | high | Keep required reason/expectedUpdatedAt and state that open quotes may be rejected/requoted; request atomic version bump or documented guarantee and test it (DASH-BR-025) | Backend implementation owner / open |
| R-033 | Existing low-stock thresholds cannot be changed through a supported endpoint | medium | medium | Show current thresholds read-only and never overload inventory deltas or undocumented CSV columns (DASH-BR-021, ADR-032) | Backend implementation owner / open |
| R-034 | Local backend readiness was transiently unavailable during Phase 08, delaying runtime checks | medium | high | Recovered without reset; current `/healthz`, `/readyz`, and dashboard `/api/health` return 200, and the six-role E2E passed. Keep readiness probes before future live tests and retain strict runtime DTO parsing (DASH-BR-020). | Local development / mitigated for this run |
| R-035 | Finance cost-price visibility requested by phase prose conflicts with the explicit role matrix and backend's Admin-only field response | low | high | Follow role matrix; keep field Admin-only until safe finance-specific permission/endpoint is approved (DASH-BR-023, ADR-033) | Owner/backend contract decision / open |
| R-036 | A stock-adjustment response can be lost after the backend commits, leaving the operator unsure whether a signed delta was applied | medium | high | Disable mutation retries; rely on `expectedVersion` as the backend stale guard; refresh inventory and open movement reads, preserve request ID, block another adjustment for that variant for the current page session, and direct the operator to the append-only ledger (ADR-035). UI failure paths are unit-tested, but successful AAL2/conflict/audit/ambiguous-write behavior remains unverified against a live authorized adjustment. | Dashboard + backend verification / open |
| R-037 | Product archive/restore lacks caller version, reason and idempotency guards; ambiguous or concurrent requests can change customer visibility and cart availability without a reliable operator reconciliation path | medium | high | Withhold archive/restore controls until DASH-BR-026 is implemented; preserve current server state, do not infer that an ambiguous POST failed, and require returned version plus before/after audit evidence before enabling the flow. | Backend security/contract owner / open |
| R-038 | Price editing depends on an unfiltered, unpaginated full-catalogue variant read to obtain each `updatedAt`; at scale this read may be slow or expensive and its live latency is unknown | medium | high | Fetch only after explicit operator intent, expose no edit form without a matching strictly parsed row, retain a visible failure/request ID, and never substitute a stale product-detail price for the concurrency token; request product-scoped/cursor pagination via DASH-BR-028. | Backend + dashboard / open |
| R-039 | Category update and reorder routes have no revision guard; concurrent edits can overwrite a previous operator's visible category changes without a detectable 409 | medium | high | Keep existing-row update/reorder/delete unavailable; permit only a reviewed unique create with no automatic retry and read reconciliation. Require category revision/expectedVersion and before/after audit before adding write controls (DASH-BR-032). | Backend security/contract owner / open |
| R-040 | The backend's collection resolver is exposed only through an undocumented query and returns an untyped shape; a local approximation could disagree with storefront ordering, stock or visibility | medium | high | Do not call the undocumented query or reproduce its SQL. Show only configured ordered product IDs/rules and request a typed, bounded preview response (DASH-BR-031). | Backend contract owner / open |
| R-041 | Collection deletion lacks a revision guard and does not check Experience Studio references; deleting could invalidate a customer-facing bundle | medium | critical | Withhold deletion until backend checks references and enforces expectedRev, reason, and safe idempotent semantics (DASH-BR-033). | Backend security/experience owner / open |
| R-042 | Category productCount excludes archived products although the delete handler blocks on any product assignment; operators may believe a category is empty when deletion would fail | low | medium | Label the count as active/non-archived only, do not expose delete, and request aligned count/blocker semantics (DASH-BR-022). | Backend implementation owner / open |
| R-043 | Catalogue CSV export has no backend row/byte cap and is buffered as a full string by commerce-api and browser; a large catalogue could exhaust memory or stall the operator tab | medium | high | Export only on explicit click, never prefetch, show that the response is complete/unpaged, and request bounded cursor/streaming or documented size limits (DASH-BR-035) | Backend + dashboard / open |
| R-044 | Pending/rejected media can be fetched from a public immutable URL because the public handler bypasses approval and DB checks; sensitive or unlicensed content is exposed immediately on upload | medium | critical | Treat every upload as public from byte 1; persistent warning and explicit public-rights confirmation; never upload customer/private content; request private pending storage and approval-gated public URLs (DASH-BR-042). Public URL revocation is not currently available. | Backend security/product owner / open |
| R-045 | BFF still buffers each media upload in memory, so concurrent operators/processes can cause memory pressure even after a per-request limit | medium | high | Dashboard now requires Content-Length, rejects >15 MiB before buffering, checks actual bytes after read, and serializes uploads per browser session (ADR-043). This bounds one request but does not control concurrency across users/instances; backend streaming/backpressure and measured deployment limits remain open (DASH-BR-043). | Dashboard / partially mitigated; backend + deployment open |
| R-046 | Incomplete media usage omits Studio references, so the archive endpoint may accept removal of a referenced asset after Studio is built | medium | critical | Withhold archive/restore and unused claims until usage includes every draft/published Experience ref and backend performs atomic versioned checks (DASH-BR-040). | Backend security/experience owner / open |
| R-047 | Media approval/rejection, rights evidence, and bundled path contracts diverge from the dashboard role/field requirements | medium | high | Keep review Admin-only; keep bundled mapping unavailable; require rights/evidence before upload and report api-index mismatch; request explicit holder, reviewer and bundle DTO/guard schemas (DASH-BR-037–039). | Backend contract/security owner / open |
| R-048 | Product and variant creation have no backend idempotency key; a lost response followed by retry can create duplicate records, while add-variant has no product version precondition or mandatory reason | medium | high | Disable automatic/manual resubmission after an uncertain result, reconcile with an authoritative read but label a match unattributed, and send products/variants inactive. Request idempotency, expectedVersion/reason for add-variant, and complete audit before/after evidence (DASH-BR-044). | Backend contract/security owner / open |
